snapshot.name: JSC "NAC Kazatomprom"
snapshot.business_summary: National Atomic Company Kazatomprom JSC explores for, produces, processes, markets, and sells uranium and uranium related products in Kazakhstan, China, the Russian Federation, Canada, France, the United Kingdom, the United States, Jersey, Cayman Islands, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Uranium and Ulba Metallurgical Plan. It also processes rare metals; and manufactures and sells beryllium, tantalum, and niobium products.
